budget_items.topic: Marshall Park master plan funding from Capital Plan
budget_items.what_was_recorded: The May 2021 Capital Plan included $50k for the Marshall Park Master Plan, of which $36,622.84 had been expended to date.
budget_items.quote: may 2021 - town meeting approval of capital plan that included $50k for marshall park

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The amount spent to date is $36,000 and the next phase is $160,000, as the Park Commission stated when asked for numbers.
budget_items.quote: the amount spent to date is $36,000 and the next phase is $160,000

budget_items.what_was_recorded: A ballpark figure of $150,000 to $200,000 was obtained for the engineering phase.
budget_items.quote: ms. lockwood stated she had gotten a ballpark figure of $150,000 to $200,000 for the engineering phase.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: WOLA gave a total estimate of around $5 million for the project; phasing was said to make costs more manageable.
budget_items.quote: wola had given us a total estimate of around $5 million for the project.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The town was awarded the full request under its Competitive Grant application, broken down into streetlight conversion, a hybrid police cruiser, and administrative assistance.
budget_items.quote: i received notification that we were awarded the full request of $187,140

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Select Board approved funding a survey of the Cowdry conservation boundary that cost eight thousand dollars.
budget_items.quote: the select board approved funding the survey and it cost eight thousand dollars.
